examples.label: Mobile number field with a country-code prefix
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-tel-field" site="Global" id="tel-mobile-number" name="mobile_number" value="" label="Mobile number" placeholder="7700 900123" description="We only use this to send delivery updates, never for marketing." space="small" rounded="medium">
  <:start_section class="gap-1 text-sm opacity-80">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-phone" class="size-4 opacity-70" />
    +44
  </:start_section>
</.component>

examples.label: Callback number on a support request form
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-tel-field" site="Global" id="tel-callback-support" name="callback_number" value="" label="Best number to call you back on" placeholder="020 7946 0018" description="Our team calls between 09:00 and 17:30, Monday to Friday." variant="bordered" color="primary" space="small" rounded="medium">
  <:end_section>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-clock" class="size-4 opacity-60" />
  </:end_section>
</.component>
